svg.text: INHERITED TOP PLATE / LT DRILLING PROPOSAL
4 × Ø22 on 300 × 300 grid · M20 × 70 through bolts
Two 25 × 310 edge reliefs · 15 nominal catch clearance
20 mm plate inherited from DT3; DT4 acceptance pending. Yaw-flange screws: M16 × 40 countersunk; nominal usable engagement 18 mm.
Through bolts: paired NL20 under head and nut. Drilling, preload, plate flex and bolster welds require acceptance; DT source not altered.
LT4 R0 · 2026-10-19 | mm · NTS | FITS / WELDS PROVISIONAL
